q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: WITH total_per_bar AS (SELECT DISTINCT bar, COUNT(drinker) AS dc FROM frequents GROUP BY bar), average_per_bar AS (SELECT bar, AVG(price) AS av FROM serves GROUP BY bar), max_visits AS (SELECT bar, drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE times_a_week = (SELECT MAX(f2.times_a_week) FROM frequents AS f2 WHERE f1.bar = f2.bar)) SELECT DISTINCT TPB.bar, TPB.dc, APB.av, MAX(mv.drinker) FROM total_per_bar AS TPB JOIN average_per_bar AS APB ON TPB.bar = APB.bar JOIN max_visits AS mv ON APB.bar = mv.bar GROUP BY TPB.bar, TPB.dc, APB.av ORDER BY TPB.dc DESC
